name: AgentInstance
description: An agent instance: a device instance (the Identity Object Model's idm.entry agentInstance row) or a workload agent (agent_identity), keyed by the agent_id its client attestations carry. id is the agent_id.

attributes.name: register
attributes.description: Which register holds the instance: device_instance or workload_agent.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: The instance's standing: active, suspended or revoked. revoked is terminal. Writable by PATCH.

attributes.name: active
attributes.description: Whether status is active. PATCH active false suspends, true reactivates.

attributes.name: status_reason
attributes.description: The reason recorded with the last status change. Written by PATCH with a status change, at most 256 characters; returned for workload agents (a device instance keeps it in its ledger entry, not on the row).

subAttributes.name: value
subAttributes.description: For a device instance, the owner's PingOne subject (the involvedParty row's pingoneUserId, the key the SCIM user store writes); for a workload agent, the OAuth client_id the agent was minted under.

subAttributes.name: issuer
subAttributes.description: For a workload agent, the attester (iss) the agent was minted by.

attributes.name: device
attributes.description: The device a device instance runs on. Absent for a workload agent.

attributes.name: issuer
attributes.description: The agent platform or attester the instance belongs to: a device instance's platform entity id, a workload agent's iss.
